title: Act: Add keyboard focus flow, ARIA labels and live region to ObjectOverlay
summary: Add aria labels, the live region and DOM focus movement to the overlay.
description: ObjectOverlay renders a role=group region with aria-label, per-button aria-label, an aria-live polite region from focusedObjectId, and moves focus to the first action on Enter for a focused object.
acceptance_criteria: Live region text derives from store focus and content
technical_constraints: Labels from the same game state
definition_of_done: Live region present while focus is set

steps.action: Add role='group' and aria-label={object.name} on the action container; aria-label={`${action.label} ${object.name}`} on each button; always render a visually-hidden div role='status' aria-live='polite' whose text is `${name}. Actions: ${labels.join(', ')}` for the active object and '' otherwise; add onKeyDown on the container: Escape calls phaserToReact.emit('menuClose',{}).
On objectClick also keep selectedId; pass a focusFirstAction flag to ObjectOverlay when selectedId equals activeId so its first button receives DOM focus through a ref in a useEffect.
